caveats: Built entirely on GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3 with gtnhdeterminism 0.11 (fix jar md5 46411be73aca74cfb6737c372e26e5d1) from cold radius-60 full-generation probes, one per dimension. No layer is carried over from the earlier daily-707 build.

Structure positions moved in 0.11. Thaumcraft hilltop circles, Thaumcraft barrows and vanilla WorldGenDungeons rooms are now sited from virgin terrain instead of live terrain, so their coordinates differ from any pre-0.11 map of this seed. Verified identical across walk orders on 24 seeds.

hilltops / barrows / vanilla_dungeons in pois.json are OBSERVED, not predicted. Stage 0 has no entry for Thaumcraft outer-world structures and does not enumerate dungeon rooms, so unlike the village/roguelike/stronghold/witchery POIs these exist only because the world was generated. This seed has 0 barrows inside the mapped radius (91 candidate sites, none pass the flatness test) — an absence, not missing data.

loot.json is full-generation derived: 1729 inventories with the contents that actually generated, at real Y. MINESHAFT LOOT IS ABSENT. The probe collects inventories by walking tile entities, so EntityMinecartChest never reaches it — 154 minecart chests in this window are in the world and not on this map, capping chest coverage at about 92%. Their contents are not recorded anywhere; see the open-work queue in gtnh-determinism/docs/HANDOFF.md.

base-blocks.png is a block-level raster and block-level output is NOT yet route-stable: warm vs cold measured 547 of 14641 chunks differing at radius 60. These rasters come from cold runs. Chest and structure layers are unaffected — those are identical warm vs cold.
